"""Contact sheet rows for substitute teachers."""

from typing import List

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Student


# ---
def contact_rows(students: List[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Text rows of name, section and email, sorted by name."""
    if not students:
        raise ProjectError("no students to list")
    # fail on the first student without an email
    for student in students:
        if not student.email:
            raise ProjectError(
                f"no email for {student.display_name}"
            )
    ordered = sorted(students, key=lambda item: item.display_name)
    name_width = max(len(item.display_name) for item in ordered)
    sect_width = max(len(item.section) for item in ordered)
    rows = []
    # pad each column so the rows line up
    for student in ordered:
        name = student.display_name.ljust(name_width)
        section = student.section.ljust(sect_width)
        rows.append(f"{name}  {section}  {student.email}")
    return rows
EOF
cat > tests/test_contacts.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Student

ADA = Student("1", "Lovelace", "Ada", "A", "ada@example.org")
BOB = Student("2", "Hu", "Bob", "B2", "bob@example.org")


class ContactRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sorted_by_name(self):
        rows = contact_rows([ADA, BOB])
        self.assertTrue(rows[0].startswith("Hu, Bob"))

    def test_columns_line_up(self):
        rows = contact_rows([ADA, BOB])
        self.assertEqual(rows[0].index("B2"), rows[1].index("A "))

    def test_row_has_email(self):
        self.assertTrue(contact_rows([ADA])[0].endswith(ADA.email))

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        nomail = Student("3", "Poe", "Cy", "A")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProjectError, "Poe, Cy"):
            contact_rows([ADA, nomail])

    def test_empty_list(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])
EOF
